title: 高鐵分割
description: 列車掠過高架橋，橋身與藍天形成交錯的線條。
descriptionEn: A passing train, an elevated railway and blue sky form intersecting lines.

title: 行李車
description: 停機坪上的黃色行李牽引車與綠色覆布。
descriptionEn: A yellow airport tug pulls baggage covered in green canvas.

title: 橋墩・秩序
description: 橋墩、拱形與水面倒影組成重複的幾何形狀。
descriptionEn: Bridge piers, arches and reflections repeat across the water.

title: 機場屋頂
description: 深藍屋頂下，燈管與金屬結構交錯延伸。
descriptionEn: Lights and metal structures cross beneath a deep blue roof.

title: 薄霧車站
description: 透過車窗，看見薄霧與遠處城市的輪廓。
descriptionEn: Mist softens the distant city beyond the train window.

title: 煙囪色彩
description: 藍天下的條紋煙囪、白煙與彩色屋頂。
descriptionEn: A striped chimney and white smoke rise above a colourful roof.

title: 向光而上
description: 機場的扶梯向明亮窗邊延伸，藍色屋頂與金屬線條交錯。
descriptionEn: An airport escalator rises towards bright windows beneath a blue roof.

title: 磚塔之門
description: 彩色磚牆與層疊紋樣，圍出一扇深色的拱門。
descriptionEn: Layers of patterned brickwork surround a dark arched doorway.

title: 落日垂釣
description: 夕陽映亮海面，岸邊的釣者留下一道剪影。
descriptionEn: A lone angler is silhouetted against a glowing sea and sunset.

title: 雲的倒影
description: 水面映出暮色雲層與城市的倒影。
descriptionEn: Evening clouds and city buildings appear in the water below.

title: 海底海星
description: 淺水中的海星與石塊，被流動的水紋重新描繪。
descriptionEn: Moving ripples redraw the starfish and stones in shallow water.

title: 湖中線條
description: 平靜的湖水裡，細桿與線條劃出簡約的構圖。
descriptionEn: Slender poles and wires trace a quiet composition across the lake.

title: 草地・流動
description: 綠色與淺色的模糊色帶，構成抽象的自然印象。
descriptionEn: Soft green and pale bands turn the landscape into an abstraction.

title: 暗處的雞蛋花
description: 暗綠葉片之間，一朵白色雞蛋花迎向光。
descriptionEn: A white frangipani flower catches the light among dark leaves.

title: 水光織紋
description: 藍色泳池的水波與池底網格，交織出細密的光紋。
descriptionEn: Blue ripples and a tiled pool floor weave a fine pattern of light.

title: 蘆葦之間
description: 逆光裡的蘆葦與遠處人影，呈現細緻而朦朧的層次。
descriptionEn: Backlit reeds and distant figures form soft, textured layers.

title: 火烈鳥
description: 深色背景裡，火烈鳥的粉紅羽毛與曲線相互呼應。
descriptionEn: Pink feathers and curved necks echo against a dark background.

title: 白狐的凝視
description: 白狐近距離的目光與細緻蓬鬆的毛髮。
descriptionEn: A close encounter with a white fox, its gaze and soft fur.

title: 長頸鹿的眼睛
description: 近距離觀察長頸鹿的眼睛、睫毛與斑紋。
descriptionEn: A close study of a giraffe’s eye, eyelashes and patterned coat.

title: 兩隻黑天鵝
description: 兩隻黑天鵝相伴游過帶有綠色倒影的水面。
descriptionEn: Two black swans glide through green reflections on the water.

title: 回望
description: 樹幹旁的動物回望鏡頭，枝條與背景交錯。
descriptionEn: An animal looks towards the camera among branches and tree trunks.

title: 力量與靜止
description: 樹旁站立的袋鼠，呈現肌肉線條與安靜的姿態。
descriptionEn: A standing kangaroo reveals muscular lines in a quiet pose.

title: 犀牛側影
description: 犀牛的側臉與粗糙皮膚，在柔和的光中顯出質感。
descriptionEn: Soft light reveals the contours and textured skin of a rhinoceros.

title: 水邊小聚
description: 幾隻鴿子聚在淺水邊，白色與深色羽毛相互映襯。
descriptionEn: Pigeons gather in shallow water, their pale and dark feathers contrasting.

title: 半臉折扇
description: 黑色折扇遮住半張臉，目光從扇緣上方望向鏡頭。
descriptionEn: A gaze meets the camera above the edge of a black folding fan.

title: 藍裙・舞步
description: 展場燈光之下，藍白裙裝與抬起的腳形成輕盈姿態。
descriptionEn: A lifted foot and a blue-and-white dress suggest a light dance step.

title: 青色窗前
description: 明亮的青色窗框前，一幅藍白色調的人像。
descriptionEn: A portrait in blue and white, framed by a bright turquoise window.

title: 銀狼
description: 灰色背景前的角色人像，銀髮與藍色服飾相互映襯。
descriptionEn: Silver hair and blue clothing stand out against a grey backdrop.

title: 祈願
description: 紅色廟宇長廊裡，一個雙手合十的安靜時刻。
descriptionEn: Hands meet in prayer within the red corridors of a temple.

title: 回眸
description: 沿著綠色圍欄與小徑，遠處的人回身看向鏡頭。
descriptionEn: A distant figure turns back along a path beside a green fence.

title: 靜坐花間
description: 花枝與石階之間，藍白裙裝的人物安靜坐著。
descriptionEn: A seated figure in blue and white rests among flowers and stone steps.

title: 粉色角色
description: 展場裡的粉色角色人像，在深色背景前呈現鮮明色彩。
descriptionEn: A pink costume brings vivid colour to a dark exhibition setting.
